name: Premiere Packaging, Inc.
old_description: For over 50 years, clients have relied on us to safeguard their world recognized brands by delivering outstanding quality, unwavering reliability, and low cost, exceptional service while meeting exacting product specifications.
about:
Premiere Packaging, Inc. operates from a 130,000-square-foot facility on 14 acres in Flint, Michigan. The company was founded in 1969 as a family-owned business and remains family and employee owned today; it adopted the Premiere Packaging name in 1987 when it moved into its current building.

The company provides contract packaging services including custom blending, filling, and packaging of liquids, creams, gels, and pastes in sizes from 1/4 ounce up to 5 gallons and bulk totes. Its capabilities cover shrink-sleeve and pressure-sensitive labeling, kit assembly, blister packaging, tube and cartridge filling, pouch sealing, warehousing, club-pallet and combo packaging, as well as materials management, production planning, and logistics. The site includes 225,000 gallons of indoor and outdoor bulk chemical storage plus an 18,000-square-foot offsite warehouse, and an on-site laboratory staffed with chemists and engineers.

Premiere serves manufacturers of household and commercial cleaning products, including spray and gel cleaners, disinfectants, floor care, liquid dish soaps, dish gels, rinse agents, cream cleansers, fabric and laundry care, air care sprays, commercial concentrates, degreasers, and specialty chemicals such as bleach, abrasives, micro-sensitives, organic acids, flammables, peroxides, and oxidizers. Its customer base ranges from global Fortune 500 companies to smaller regional brands.

The company emphasizes a history of customer-awarded recognition for vendor excellence, quality assurance, safety, cost control, and innovation. It maintains a fully documented quality management system comparable to ISO 9001, uses real-time statistical process control (cpk, Tz, Cr tracking), and operates a certified odor panel and advanced instrumentation (HPLC, GC, UV-VIS, FTIR) to protect brand integrity.
